pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 76 degrees, relative humidity 42 percent, barometer 30.00 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,859 feet, track temperature 117 degrees.

Hagan and Vandergriff have each won 1 times against the other in prior events and this is the first time they
have faced each other in a final round.

Vandergriff with a slight starting line advantage and the lead until the engine started to go away.  Hagan
drives around Vandergriff in the lights for the win.  Hagan wins his third Wally this season and the 58th of
his career.
